text:
rachel: Quick brainstorm for the benchmark launch: want a tight narrative that centers on SLA-vs-cost as a playable tradeoff. Need one hero visual, a compact savings table, and a gated calculator. targets: devs (self-serve) + infra buyers (ROI).
diego: Hero visual idea: a simple 'SLA slider' mock 10k-1s p95 on x, $/1k on y, with a shaded band showing configs that meet a given SLA. shows choices not absolutes.
sam: Savings table = rows (workloads), cols (knobs) with pragmatic % ranges. Avoid maxed-out claims. Also include one-line caption per row: what to expect in real deployments.
toni: Design notes: single-column thumbnail-friendly hero (1200x630), accessible color palette, dashed fallback model traces, and a tiny inset showing batching knee. Export PNG + SVG.
benchbot: data export https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/1758889998 file: sla-cost-snap.csv (includes batch sizes, cache toggles, quant variants).
diego: Gated calc: spreadsheet with sliders + CSV import. Also add a tiny API sample for quick estimates. CTA split: "Try the calc" (devs) vs "Request ROI review" (buyers).
rachel: Routing: capture monthly_tokens and target_sla; bucket <100k self-serve, 100k-1M nurture, >1M SDR. Tag leads 'sla_cost_bench'.
sam: I'll prepare the realistic deltas and kneepoint numbers (no marketing math) by Tue AM.
toni: I'll mock visuals Tue EOD. PNGs ready Wed.
drachel: (typo)
rachel: Final timeline: numbers Tue, visuals Wed, page + gated calc Fri, webinar following week. Owners set. Quick follow-ups: sam include variance bands, toni ensure thumbnail readability, diego make notebook prototype optional for advanced users. :sparkles:
